positions.pos: Your steer, built as the new growth (it replaces sg-grows-into-shape). A spirit has three stages. Level 1, gas: a drifting cloud of motes in its element's colours, thickest at the heart, with no shape; the way it drifts hints at the urge. Level 3, core: the gas solidifies into a faceted core, a gem cut for its family (the Shellback's is a six-sided double pyramid, a shell scute made solid), with a few motes still circling it. Level 5, hologram: the core projects a body of light into the world from a projector ring, the way the gems in Steven Universe project their forms. The body is faceted, see-through and scanlined, in its family's shape and the animal base you picked, with the core showing at its chest; the nation's style and the pieces you choose are projected onto it. An ally beaten in a fight falls back into its core and projects again after rest, so a spirit is never lost. Levels are placeholders. First proof: the Shellback in all three stages and five elements, as models and sprites (https://claude.ai/artifact/B9zYsNyxe6UVhRF3jcNP85). This stands unless you flip it.

Something more like a ghost or a geometric version. Maybe more holographic. Maybe even starting as a gas’s that solidifying into a core which then makes for a holographic ally that’s being projected into the world. Kind of like Steven Universe". sg-body-from A (the urge picks the family). spirit-growth-by-training (no death).

positions.pos: Your steer on sg-shape-choice, built: wild spirits you defeat drop loot, a shard of their element and family (a Tinker's claw shard, a Watcher's eye shard, a Water mote). You can offer a shard to a spirit you have allied with. It adds that piece to what the ally is offered at its next bond step, beside the pieces its training offers, and the ally's satisfaction rises by one. Loot never trains a stat: stats still come only from playing well (sg-loop-trains). Offering is how you steer a spirit's shape, so beating Watchers lets you give your Shellback an owl's crest. Numbers are drafts. This stands unless you flip it.
